trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 are done. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, side strands before the finale, then activities, collectibles and the crime trophies — and this one pops last. Nothing here is missable if the rest are earned, so there is no separate step to it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first thing the story asks of you, so it cannot be missed — play the opening and it pops. Either approach to the mission counts; completing it is what matters.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions until the chapter closes. No side content is needed for it — the chapter ends when its last story mission does.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: main missions only, in order. The chapter ends when its last story mission does.

Story missions are played in order, and this one can only be earned while the mission is live — unless the game lets you replay missions from the pause menu, which is not yet confirmed for this game. Play Breakfast Run carefully when it comes, and do not skip its cutscenes or objectives.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long grind: story, side strands, activities, collectibles and the counted trophies all feed the percentage. Use the in-game stats page to see what is left — the exact checklist behind 100% is not published yet, so treat this as the last trophy before the platinum and check the stats page as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts count whenever the game flashes one — jumps, near misses and airtime all feed it. Chain them on long straight roads and off ramps; the counter is cumulative across the whole game, so there is no need to do them in one session.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The types are the activities the game offers — the shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation spots, hunting and stunt events are the ones this list names; the in-game activities menu is the check. Open that menu and tick them off one by one; one try each is enough, no score needed.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find a shooting range, work through its challenges and gold each one. Gold medals are about accuracy and time, so use a steady weapon and learn each challenge's layout before going for gold — the range lets you retry a challenge, so a failed run costs nothing.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own drone race; win each one once. Learn the course on a practice run, then race to win — the win is what counts, not the time.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — street, off-road or whatever the game lists. Pick the races that suit your vehicle, and do not re-run one you have already won: only different races add to the count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and beat his catch in the challenge. Fishing challenges are about timing the reel — wait for the bite, then keep the tension in the zone.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine, start any game on it and play it through to the end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you like.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. Do his strand before the final story mission — side strands can lock after the finale, and that is not yet confirmed either way for this game.
trophies.missable_note: Side strand — it may lock after the final story mission. Finish Andy's strand before the finale to be safe.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same as Andy's strand: play Kenton's missions to the last one, before the finale to be safe.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — meet them, play their strands through, and count 8 finished. Some strands only open after certain story points, so check the map after each chapter; finish them before the finale to be safe.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger strands may lock after the final story mission. Finish 8 of them before the finale to be safe.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. Meditation spots are marked in the world; visit each one and meditate. Work through them region by region so none is left behind.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks a unique animal to hunt; track it and take it down. Unique animals are one of a kind, so follow Bret's directions rather than hunting at random.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Collect as you explore, and trade duplicates if the game allows it — the game launched yesterday, so no card map is published yet.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo and tagging activity — find its spots across Leonida and use it at 100 of them. The count is cumulative, so work through them as you travel.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — the in-game challenges list shows them. Any 50 count, so take the easy ones first and let the rest come as you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Use the countryside or water to lose the search, and do not pick up a new wanted level on the way out.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob a shop with your partner, then two more in a row while the same wanted level is still running — do not let it clear between robberies, and do not let it rise so high you cannot keep moving. Plan a route with three shops close together.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Any vehicle you get into for the first time counts — drive everything you see. The count is cumulative across the game, so vary your rides as you travel.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode — trigger it with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends. Pick a spot with clustered enemies, and use a fast weapon so all five fall inside one use.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the airport — the wording points to taking a plane out yourself rather than booking a flight, so steal an aircraft on the field and take off. That reading is ours, from the description; any aircraft on the field should count, and getting airborne is the trigger.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks. The description is a joke, not an instruction — the trophy is tied to the Rhino in some way, most likely driving or using one. Get into a Rhino and use it; the exact trigger is not yet published, so this one is marked as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Own advice — trigger unconfirmed, no walkthrough published yet

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses calling it in. Plan the entry, move when the staff are not looking, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault robberies, each ending with your escape. Plan each one — entry, the vault, and the getaway — and do not count a vault you fail to escape from.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, take what it carries, and get away clean. Trucks run set routes, so watch for one and strike when the road is clear.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. The map tracks which areas you have visited; drive or fly through each one until all 52 are marked. Sweep region by region so the last few are easy to find.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations; hit one operation per gang, all nine. The gangs are spread across Leonida, so this one takes you to every corner of the map.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. Any cocktail counts — the view is the point.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a vehicle in a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass — the classic exit. Any showroom counts.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game — follow through on your shots. Any score counts; finishing the game is what matters.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to your partnership — most likely a moment with your partner that draws a crowd or goes big. The description gives no step, so the trigger is unconfirmed; keep playing the partner story and it should come.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Own advice — trigger unconfirmed, no walkthrough published yet

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The game tracks your choices — 500 of them, per the tracked count. Choices come up in missions and in the world; make them as you play and the count climbs. Some choices are one-time story decisions, so think before you pick — a choice you skip may not come back. Keeping a save from before big decisions is the safe play.
trophies.missable_note: Choices are one-time story decisions — a choice you skip or pick may not come back. Think before you pick, and keep a save from before big decisions.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one pops when something works on the second try — most likely a retry after a failure. The description gives no step, so the trigger is unconfirmed; keep playing and retry what fails instead of reloading a save, and it should come.
trophies.missable_note: It pops on a second try — if you reload a save instead of retrying, the moment may pass. Retry what fails rather than reloading.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Own advice — trigger unconfirmed, no walkthrough published yet

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is a strange-event trophy — something odd in the world, seen once. It is the kind of thing that happens in one place at one time, so if you see something strange, stay and watch it through. No location is published yet, so this one is unconfirmed.
trophies.missable_note: A one-off strange event in the world — if you see something odd, stay and watch it through. No location is published yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Own advice — trigger unconfirmed, no walkthrough published yet

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by is attacking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — line up a target and knock them down as you pass. Do it at speed, from the vehicle, with a melee weapon in hand.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts and the total climbs. Keep laundering as you earn — the count is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, whatever. Spend as you play and the total climbs; the count is cumulative.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida; own all eight. Buy them as you can afford them — each one also stores your vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find — ten of them. Any vehicle counts, so register the ones you drive most.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Own advice, from the official description — not yet checked in the game
